newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slumps as IPE futures tumble.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slumps as IPE futures tumble.

text.p: NWE physical gas oil fell sharply on Friday reflecing $3 a tonne losses on IPE futures. Premiums were broadly steady.
March IPE gas oil was down $2.75 a tonne at $170.75 after hitting a seven-month, spot contract low of $169.75.
Mild weather in much of Europe tempered demand in a market that was slowly recovering from industry functions that took place in London this week.
Heating oil barge premiums held around $1.75-2.00 a tonne for second half February material with first half March around 50 cents lower.
FOD cargoes looked unchanged around March IPE +$2-4 cif NWE for second half Feb with DIN around March IPE +$6. Russian product look steady around March IPE +$1-2 cif NWE.
EN590 was well supported with buying interest seen into France and from a trader.
"We are seeing barges up to March IPE +$17 and cargoes around March IPE +$19," said one dealer.
